meta.objective: Move Media Cloud acquisition from Convex actions into the Temporal worker, harden the smoke ladder around the migrated path, and reduce Railway bootstrap/manual drift so the infra is ready for V4 launch operations.

decisions: Keep Media Cloud inside engine-temporal rather than introducing a new microservice.
Use the existing Railway sincere-freedom project as the reference environment to simplify, not as a one-off snowflake.
Treat smoke verification and contributor bootstrap as first-class deliverables of the migration.
